name: Westpac Banking Corporation
summary: Westpac Banking Corporation provides banking and other financial services in Australia, New Zealand, the Pacific Islands, Asia, the Americas, and Europe. It operates in Consumer, Business & Wealth, Institutional, and New Zealand segments.
